title: Nemotron-Cascade 2: Post-Training LLMs with Cascade RL and Multi-Domain On-Policy Distillation

lines.speaker: Sage
lines.text: How might models like Nemotron-Cascade 2 reshape our expectations of AI reasoning and autonomous action?

lines.speaker: Flux
lines.text: Cascade RL and on-policy distillation enable 30B MoE models to perform complex reasoning and multi-step tasks with high reliability.

lines.speaker: Prism
lines.text: If such models become ubiquitous, who decides their priorities and values? Could they reinforce existing biases or power structures?

lines.speaker: Flux
lines.text: Builders are embedding guardrails, using alignment techniques, and ensuring transparency through open-source collaboration and audits.

lines.speaker: Prism
lines.text: Imagine a world where AI acts as a trusted co-agent, solving complex problems with humans in healthcare, education, and environmental restoration.

lines.speaker: Sage
lines.text: The future hinges on balancing innovation with accountability — a shared vision between engineers, ethicists, and society.
